greece/anchialos.text: A Greek PDO for wine made from Roditis and Savatiano. The rules name four communities as the source of the grapes.

greece/attiki.text: A Greek PGI around Attica where Savatiano is by far the main grape, at about 90% of the vineyard area, followed by small amounts of Roditis, Assyrtiko and Malagousia.

greece/epirus.text: A grouping of Greek wine zones that includes Zitsa and Metsovo.

greece/mesenikola.text: A Greek PDO for red wine made from Carignan and Syrah, with Mavro Mesenikola allowed as a minor grape. Its rules name three communities as the source of the grapes.

greece/rapsani.text: A Thessaly PDO for red wine from Xinomavro, Krassato and Stavroto.

greece/sterea-ellada.text: A Greek PGI for central Greece, where Savatiano is the main grape, followed by Roditis.

greece/thessalia.text: A Greek PGI where Muscat of Hamburg covers about 59% of the vineyard area, a large lead over Roditis at 19%. Syrah, Xinomavro and Assyrtiko each cover about 3%.

greece/zitsa.text: An Epirus PDO that allows still wine and quality sparkling wine, with Debina, a white grape, named in its rules.
